_what: The ONE model route. Every caller — email, static ads, pages, video — routes through this table, so nobody chooses a model in their own code any more. It is read, never hard-coded: `image_production/route.py` walks `route` top to bottom and takes the first row whose `when` matches, then looks the model up in `models`. MODEL IDS COME FROM THE HOUSE (LD-78 (house picture models)): no row here names its vendor model — `route.table()` fills each row's `vendor_model` from components/generative-model-house (gpt-image-person ← pictures.generate, gpt-image-edit ← pictures.edit, gemini-image-object ← pictures.object, judge ← behind.judge) and records the job in `house_job`; a job the house does not answer, or a house door that is not the row's `provider`, is refused by name. This table keeps the doors: endpoints, params, sizes, key.
_why: RULE ROUTE-1: one route table decides which model makes a picture; no caller picks a model privately. Inputs: a picture request (purpose, direction, frame, references). Output: the model row and the reason. Every row names its registry entry, or says plainly that the registry has none.
_curator: RULE ROUTE-2: this table is curated apart from components/models/models.json. The registry says what the company may call; this table says what a picture routes to. The registry is read here and never edited from here.
_keys: A key is read by NAME, never by path: the process environment first, then the one key file ~/.upright-keys.env (add NAME=value there), through components/keys/loader.py. No key is ever read out of a file in the repo or the home folder, printed, logged or written into a run record.

_route_ruling: RULE ROUTE-6: every picture, with a person in it or not, fresh or an edit, goes to GPT Image: one look across a batch, one set of quirks, one prompt style. gemini-image-object stays declared as an alternate, never routed to. It takes no mask, which is why a region edit cannot be its job.

gate._what: RULE GATE-1 (inputs are hard): every NEW picture carries its variable sheet (a recipe). A picture call with no recipe, or a recipe with a blank, is refused by name before it reaches any door. It applies to plain.make for kind `picture` (static ads, the Prompt Bench) and to the engine for the purposes in recipe_required_purposes; not to an edit of a picture (governed by its approved base and its own change request), not to emails, and not yet to a carousel slide (kind `slide`: no slide sheet exists; listed in recipe_kinds_without_sheet until one does). RULE GATE-2: a picture we made may only be a reference or an edit source with a record: approved, chosen (a path with no output judge is its own chosen attempt), or scored below_criteria, which is allowed and carries its flag; one never chosen or judged is refused. RULE GATE-3 (outputs never hold a flow): max_attempts.pictures attempts in total across the ladder, each judged and scored; the best (tie: the later) goes forward, flagged below_criteria with its failed checks if it did not pass.

max_attempts._what: ONE paid picture (2026-11-25, the clip rule ONE PAID TAKE carried to pictures): a picture that misses a check goes forward flagged; a remake changes an input and is a person's press. Measured 25 Oct to 25 Nov: 80 judged pictures cost 201 paid tries and 46 of them failed all three on the same check. A failed or refused call makes nothing and is not counted, so the ladder still finishes the work.

made_by_tool._what: RULE GATE-5 (only the tool's pictures reach the Meta approval page, 2026-11-11): every picture this tool delivers is fingerprinted (sha256) in run.json / the .recipe.json beside it and in the ledger ~/.image-production/made.jsonl (image_production/provenance.py). The Meta approval filer (meta-upload to_check.py) refuses a video thumbnail or an image/carousel picture whose bytes are in no record, and the approval page shows the check `made_by_tool` red on a card filed after `since`. A frame grab, words typed on afterwards, a hand composite or split, a picture from another door, or any edit after delivery has no record. Cards filed before `since` are left as filed. Video files are out of scope. creator: a creator's own posted picture is their footage, not a made picture.

set_required._what: RULE GATE-4 (every picture comes from a filed 3D set print, 2026-11-10; no exceptions, cast sheets and pictures with no person included): image_production/set_gate.py refuses before any door a picture whose base is not a kept print of a filed set (engine: `set`; plain: IMAGE 1; the video doors, casting and the Studio: the first reference or a named from_print; the picture doors themselves for any caller no gate cleared). ROLLBACK: `on: false` puts everything back as it was; a lane set to false puts that lane back alone (statics: the engine's ad, page and product pictures, the board, the Picture Bench, image-teardown, image-edit; email: the email pictures; video: video stills, the Video Studio, the video machine; cast: cast sheets and casting; direct: any other caller of the picture doors; sessions: the session hook that blocks picture tools typed by hand). PICTURE_GATE_OFF=all or a comma list does the same on one machine.
set_required._sessions: TEMPORARY, 2026-11-12 (the email lead): the sessions lane is off so the editor can make her email pictures the way she works, by her own Claude. First for the Brand B Nov 21-22 emails (done 2026-11-12); kept off the same day on the email lead's word because the emails after them need hand-made pictures too. the owner told. Back on: true, on the owner's or the email lead's word, or once the editor's email pictures go through a route the gate passes. Row in team/rollbacks.md.
set_required._email_at_rest: With the email lane off: true keeps the older email rule (a product shown at rest is a 3D set print, held until one is filed); false (2026-11-11, owner's call, email production was stuck) uses a kept print when one exists, else one plain picture from the product's casting sheet. Rollback: true.

edits._what: THE EDIT LANE (2026-11-10): the 3D rule is for new production; a picture already approved or live is changed by a masked edit (region) on it, the model painting only inside the box and every pixel outside kept. Base: the set's kept print or an approved original (picture_sets.py put --original F --note "approved: ..."). ROLLBACK: on false refuses every masked edit again; PICTURE_GATE_OFF=edits on one machine.
edits._door: The edit lane's door takes a real mask (OpenAI images/edits with a mask: the model paints only inside the box). The plain-edit door (gpt-image-edit, no mask) repainted the whole frame on the first live run (10 Nov, the 5-pack bag removal): pasting the box back left doubled tubes and a hard seam. Rollback: remove `door` to go back to gpt-image-edit.
edits._off: Switched off 2026-11-10 by the owner after the first live use: a change to an approved picture is a 3D rebuild too (a little more work, far fewer problems). The lane stays built; on true opens it again.

cover._what: THE COVER JOB (2026-11-12): purpose `cover` makes one cover per version of a video ad (image_production/covers.py, `make.py covers --job`). Each part has its own switch. ROLLBACK: `on: false` refuses purpose `cover` (covers are made as purpose `ad`, as before); `source_frame: false` puts the set's kept print back as the base with the video frame riding after it as a reference; `product_with_set: false` stops bringing the product in from its 3D kit when a set is named (the picture model draws it from the product photo, as before); `words_step: false` hands the words back to the picture model, written into the prompt (turn `faces` off with it, or no cover is fit to file: the words' place is not known); `own_video: false` takes a request with no `video` or `t` and does not check the frame against its video; `frame_not_made: false` counts only a frame with a .recipe.json beside it as a picture we made (not the ledger, run records, covers.json, .cover.json or a generated/ folder); `one_type: false` fits a single request with no `type` to its own headline alone (no `ad` needed, no cover-type.json read or written); `faces: false` lets a cover whose faces were not read be fit to file; `swipe_concept: false` takes any swipe id, placeholders too, and a cover with no direction whose swipe has no rated move in the index. `video_stream: false` takes a `video` that is not a real video stream with a duration (a still picture reads as a one-frame video); `made_look: false` refuses a frame as a picture we made only by its bytes and records, not by how it looks (a re-saved or re-encoded copy of a cover or its plate is taken); `unfit_exit: false` lets `make.py` with one cover request exit 0 on a delivered cover that is not `ok`. IMAGE_COVER_OFF=all or a comma list of the part names does the same on one machine. Rows in team/rollbacks.md: COVER-PURPOSE, COVER-CHECKS.

ladder._what: RULE LADDER-1: the order a picture is attempted in. `retry` = one more try on the same model when it is busy or broken; a REFUSAL moves to the next rung at once. The run record carries which rung made it and every attempt. The last rung is the transitional OpenAI net.
